Agent Name: Planner
 Step Number: 6
 Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread and misstated the source, incorrectly claiming Archduke Leopold Salvator’s mother was “Archduchess Maria Theresa of Austria” despite the WebSurfer showing the Wikipedia page clearly listing his mother as Princess Maria Immaculata of Bourbon-Two Sicilies. This synthesis error contradicted the presented evidence and led to the wrong identification of the paternal grandmother.
